# mooncake vault

Manage Age-encrypted secrets stored in a vault directory

## Description

Store secrets encrypted at rest in your config repo.

Quick start:
  mooncake vault init                    # generate identity (once per machine)
  mooncake vault recipients add $(mooncake vault pubkey) --name $(hostname)
  mooncake vault add db/password         # encrypts for all registered recipients

Add a new machine:
  # on new machine: mooncake vault init && mooncake vault pubkey
  mooncake vault recipients add AGE1... --name newmachine
  mooncake vault rekey                   # re-encrypt all secrets for new recipient
  git add vault/ && git commit && git push

Environment variables:
  MOONCAKE_VAULT_IDENTITY  path to Age identity file (default: ~/.config/mooncake/vault-identity.txt)
  MOONCAKE_VAULT_DIR       path to vault directory   (default: ~/.config/mooncake/vault/)

## Subcommands

- [add](vault_add.md) — Add or update an encrypted secret
- [init](vault_init.md) — Generate a new Age identity (private key) for this machine
- [list](vault_list.md) — List secrets in the vault directory
- [pubkey](vault_pubkey.md) — Print the public key (Age recipient) of the current identity
- [recipients](vault_recipients.md) — Manage the vault recipients list (vault/recipients.txt)
- [rekey](vault_rekey.md) — Re-encrypt all secrets for the current recipients list
